title: allow `go test -overlay` with an overlay file in the role temp dir as the documented way for UI passes to render without touching the tree

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261118-130342-787e, project ork, item S431:

allow `go test -overlay` with an overlay file in the role temp dir as the documented way for UI passes to render without touching the tree

Evidence: a `mkdir -p ... && go test -overlay ...` compound was auto-denied; a plain `go -C ... test -overlay ...` ran
